title: Auto Replant +
description: Auto replant with a little tweak
body:
### AutoReplant – Smart & Safe Crop Replanting

AutoReplant is a lightweight and optimized Minecraft plugin that automatically replants crops after harvesting — with built-in delay, cooldown, and anti-lag protection.
Designed for survival servers and fully compatible with VeinMiner.

### Features

- Automatically replants fully grown crops
- Configurable activation duration
- Configurable cooldown between activations
- Batch processing system for performance safety
- Language file support (lang.yml)

### Performance and Safety

- Uses a single scheduled task for processing
- Limits the number of replants per tick
- Clears runtime data on reload and restart
- Prevents replanting without available seeds

Compatible with Spigot, Paper, and other Bukkit-based servers.
